title: Know which Pack fits
when: Agent proposes new hosting or an infrastructure/deploy Pack
need: Shipped Packs cover container runtime, host maintenance, smoke tests, branch-preview hosting, structured events and the webapp scaffold; production delivery, cloud infrastructure and DNS/CDN are project-owned. Preview actual dependencies, prerequisites and resources before approval.
surface: Onboard profile Pack proposal and domain-and-deploy “Step 7”; installed Pack README owns adaptation.
gap: Public adoption guidance needs these support limits before the user accepts a Pack. Do not present provider prose as an executable adapter.
